The '''DK-27 Guardian Droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was deployed as security in [[Kaas City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
